mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.gateway_code AS gatewayCode, g.gateway_name AS gatewayName, g.ip_address AS ipAddress, g.port, g.protocol, g.online_status AS onlineStatus, CASE g.online_status WHEN 1 THEN '在线' ELSE '离线' END AS onlineStatusText, g.last_online_time AS lastOnlineTime, g.status, CASE g.status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' ELSE '禁用' END AS statusText, g.create_by AS createBy, g.create_time AS createTime FROM agri_iot_gateway g WHERE g.id = #{id} AND g.del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_iot_gateway WHERE gateway_code = #{gatewayCode} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT g.id, g.gateway_code AS gatewayCode, g.gateway_name AS gatewayName, g.online_status AS onlineStatus, CASE g.online_status WHEN 1 THEN '在线' ELSE '离线' END AS onlineStatusText, g.status, CASE g.status WHEN 1 THEN '正常' ELSE '禁用' END AS statusText FROM agri_iot_gateway g WHERE g.del_flag = 0 AND g.status = 1 ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
